beats.say: From a refugee camp in Ghana to starring for Bayern Munich!
Alphonso Boyle Davies was born on 2 November 2000 to Liberian parents in Buduburam, a refugee camp in Ghana.
In 2005, the family emigrated to Canada, eventually settling in Edmonton.
At the age of 14, Davies relocated alone to Vancouver to join the Whitecaps FC Residency program.
On 6 June 2017, he received Canadian citizenship.
He joined Bayern in January 2019 from MLS side Vancouver Whitecaps FC and was named Bundesliga Rookie of the Season.
How did you hear about Alphonso Davies' journey?
